name: Till Death Brings us Together
source:
There has been a horrible mix-up. You are an unfortunate soul that suddenly needs to survive the Egyptian weighing of the heart.  

But even if you survive the weighing, the soul-devourer Ammit has taken a keen interest in you. She wants to savour your delicious heart.  

You are given one chance to save yourself, though. Choose one of the canopic jars to guard you, and consume the viscera contained inside to conscript your bodyguard.  Will your choice of guard protect you, though? Or will she betray you in the end?

[From [url=https://fellowfroggy.itch.io/till-death-brings-us-together]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
阴差阳错之下闹出了一桩可怕的乌龙——你成了一个倒霉透顶的亡魂，冷不防必须直面古埃及亡灵审判的“心脏称量”死里逃生。

然而就算你侥幸熬过了天平审判，噬魂魔兽阿米特也已经对你产生了浓厚的兴趣——她正垂涎欲滴地想要品尝你美味的心脏。

不过，你还留有最后一次自救的机会：从卡诺卜坛中挑选一尊作为你的守护者，并吞下坛中封存的内脏，正式征召专属于你的贴身保镖。只是，你选中的这位护卫当真会尽忠保护你吗？还是说，到了最后关头她反而会背叛你？

[摘自[url=https://fellowfroggy.itch.io/till-death-brings-us-together]itch.io[/url]]
